encounters.title: The Oven That Would Not Cool

ember_ashbread_oven_entry.body: Bread is rising on every windowsill of the ash bakery, including the one marked Please Leave Clear. The oven has kept its heat since yesterday, and the baker is cooling the next batch by waving a ledger at it. A Hellhound sleeps very innocently beside the warm flue.

choices.label: Make room for the cooling loaves
choices.outcome: Your companion settles where nobody can trip over a tray. The baker gains a clear surface and a little room to think.

choices.label: Compare the oven marks with the baker's ledger
choices.outcome: Yesterday's firing needed less fuel than the ledger records. The baker realizes the hillside has been contributing heat of its own.

ember_ashbread_oven_flue.body: The flue opens onto a terrace where an old stone shutter controls the hillside draught. It has stuck halfway, trapping hot air beneath the oven. The Hellhound has followed at a careful distance and is watching the shutter with the interest of somebody whose bed may be about to change.

choices.label: Ease the shutter along its cooled edge
choices.outcome: Grit scrapes your hands before the shutter moves. The hot draught begins taking its proper route above the roof.
choices.description: Pay 3% HP; no knockouts; Temporary team defense +5%.

choices.label: Mark the safe draught positions for the baker
choices.outcome: You trace the stone's worn stops without reaching into the hot opening. The baker can adjust it after the terrace cools.

ember_ashbread_oven_rack.body: On the cooling terrace, the baker has set aside a small covered parcel for a work crew beyond the steam channel. It is not payment for fixing the oven; she would have sent it anyway. The question is whether to carry it directly or arrange a shaded handover above the steam.

choices.label: Carry the warm parcel with clear route notes
choices.outcome: The baker wraps it for a walk rather than a feast. Your companion waits while you learn where the crew is resting.

choices.label: Arrange a shaded handover point for the crew
choices.outcome: The baker wraps the parcel for that shaded handover and entrusts it to your team. You mark a shelf above the steam channel before setting off.

encounters.title: The House of Borrowed Steam

ember_pressure_house_entry.body: A low stone building breathes through three copper vents. Outside, a keeper has arranged cups beneath the leaks so she can hear which pipe is changing pressure. One cup has stopped ringing, and she is more worried by the silence than by the noise.

choices.label: Listen to the cups before opening the door
choices.outcome: The quiet pipe still carries water, but its note has shifted below the others. You mark the change for the keeper.

choices.label: Clear the keeper's route across the terrace
choices.outcome: Your team moves the cool loose stones away from her footing. She can reach each vent without stepping over the leak.

ember_pressure_house_valves.body: Inside, the valve floor is warm enough to dry your boots without asking. An old pressure wheel has slipped against a brace, leaving a side channel open to a garden below. The keeper needs either room to turn the wheel or a reliable record of its present setting.

choices.label: Hold the cooled brace while she turns the wheel
choices.outcome: The weight presses into your shoulders before the brace seats. The keeper closes the unwanted channel a little at a time.
choices.description: Pay 5% HP; no knockouts; Temporary team attack +5%.

choices.label: Copy the worn marks before she adjusts anything
choices.outcome: Your companion stands clear while you trace the old settings. The keeper can return to this point if the new position proves wrong.

ember_pressure_house_garden.body: The garden below the house contains winter greens sheltering between warm pipes. Its owner has been blaming the heat for poor growth, while the keeper has been blaming the seeds. A shallow trench shows that the roots are getting steam instead of ordinary water.

choices.label: Separate the drinking trench from the warm pipes
choices.outcome: You shift cool stones into a divider and sort the loose useful gatherings aside. The roots receive water without losing their sheltered warmth.
choices.description: Pay 3% HP; no knockouts; Select the run's one material bundle; World remembers.

choices.label: Help the neighbours agree on a shared inspection
choices.outcome: They choose a clear water check before either buys new seeds. The keeper adds the garden to her ordinary morning route.

encounters.title: The Orchard under the Black Bark

ember_charred_orchard_entry.body: Blackened trunks stand in straight rows above a sheltered hollow. From the road the orchard looks finished, but green shoots are pushing through each rough coat of bark. An orchard keeper has tied little cloth flags to the branches she is afraid visitors will mistake for deadwood.

choices.label: Help make the living shoots easier to see
choices.outcome: Your companion waits beside the new growth while you move each flag into view. The keeper can stop explaining the same hopeful fact.

choices.label: Look beneath the bark without breaking it
choices.outcome: A loose edge shows the living layer sheltered underneath. You record the boundary before following the keeper into the hollow.

ember_charred_orchard_roots.body: Below the rows, a root cellar holds baskets of ash from several old fires. The keeper treats each basket as a different soil ingredient, not as a record of damage. One damp batch has grown a hard crust, and she needs room to compare what lies underneath.

choices.label: Break the cooled crust beside the sorting mat
choices.outcome: Your sleeves become grey before the crust gives way. You separate useful loose gatherings while the keeper protects her labelled samples.
choices.description: Pay 3% HP; no knockouts; Select the run's one material bundle.

choices.label: Read the dates and compare the surviving roots
choices.outcome: The oldest roots have grown around the hardest ground. You add that patient route to the keeper's notes.

ember_charred_orchard_seedtable.body: The seed table holds two plans for the next season: restore the neat rows, or leave strips of wild growth between them. The keeper wants fruit, but the little residents of the hollow need shelter too. She will try either plan if somebody helps explain how to care for it.

choices.label: Plan sheltered strips between the fruit rows
choices.outcome: You leave room for shade and small travelling paths. The keeper marks a trial strip instead of promising to transform the whole orchard at once.

choices.label: Map a careful restoration of the oldest rows
choices.outcome: The plan protects the strongest living roots. You add a separate margin for the hollow's sheltered residents.
choices.description: Use this run's research allowance; World remembers.

encounters.title: Laundry on the Cool Side of the Hill

ember_soot_laundry_entry.body: A laundry line stretches between two cooled stone posts. Its owner has washed the same white cloth twice, only to discover that the afternoon wind carries ash straight across it. She is now using it as a wind marker while deciding whether to laugh or start again.

choices.label: Find a sheltered line beyond the ash drift
choices.outcome: You compare the cloth's pull with the movement above the vents. A quiet pocket behind the terrace stays clear.

choices.label: Help find clean air for the heavy wet washing
choices.outcome: The heavy basket presses against your arms as you find a quiet pocket behind the terrace. The cloth reaches clean air, and its owner can put away the tub.
choices.description: Pay 3% HP; no knockouts; +5% of the run reward.

encounters.title: A Weaver with Stone Weights

ember_cinder_loom_entry.body: A weaver has hung stone weights from a loom built against the warm hillside. They keep the fibres taut until passing tremors make them knock together. Her unfinished cloth has begun recording the tremors as small uneven bands, which may be useful if she can stop apologizing for them.

choices.label: Read the bands as observations rather than mistakes
choices.outcome: The weaver labels the first clear pattern with a date. The cloth keeps its unevenness and gains a purpose.

choices.label: Space the hanging weights farther apart
choices.outcome: Your companion holds each fibre still while you reset its weight. The loom moves more gently when the next tremor passes.

encounters.title: A Whistle Reserved for Supper

ember_hellhound_whistle_entry.body: A Hellhound waits beside a cold cooking ring while a camp tender searches through several nearly identical whistles. One calls for supper, another warns about a vent, and the third apparently means something the Hellhound considers extremely funny. The tender would prefer not to experiment in public.

choices.label: Help compare the marks on the whistle handles
choices.outcome: The handles carry tiny use marks where the tender holds them. You sort the warnings before anybody sounds a note.

choices.label: Keep the waiting Hellhound company
choices.outcome: Your companion settles outside the cooking ring. The patient guest accepts the company without deciding it has been promised supper twice.

encounters.title: The Mittens Kept Warm

ember_borrowed_mittens_entry.body: A pair of thick mittens rests on a warm stone beside the path. A note asks travellers to use them for the nearby hot latch and put them back facing the sun. The stone has room for your tired companions too, provided nobody blocks the latch.

choices.label: Rest beside the warming stone
choices.outcome: You settle clear of the working path. The steady warmth eases the cold that has stayed in the team's damp travelling gear.

choices.label: Repair the little cover above the shared mittens
choices.outcome: You fasten the cover where ash cannot settle inside. The next traveller will find the mittens warm and usable.

encounters.title: Footprints Older than the Road

ember_cooled_footprints_entry.body: A smooth sheet of cooled rock holds a row of bootprints pointing away from the present road. A surveyor has placed her own boot beside one and discovered that the older travellers used a much shorter stride. She is wondering what they were carrying that made them move so carefully.

choices.label: Trace the prints without stepping into them
choices.outcome: The deepest impressions fall on alternating sides. You record the rhythm of a shared load rather than inventing a hurried escape.

choices.label: Mark a safe viewing edge for other travellers
choices.outcome: Your companion waits where the sheet is firm. You guide future curious feet away from the fragile impressions.

encounters.title: The Jar That Watered Its Own Path

ember_cracked_jar_entry.body: A water carrier's jar leaves a thin wet trail across the dry ground. Small green shoots follow older trails from the same crack. The carrier knows the jar wastes water, but the patch of living ground has become a useful resting place for travellers and small beasts.

choices.label: Help direct the leak into a covered drinking basin
choices.outcome: The carrier can share the water without losing it across the whole road. Your companion tests the basin's sheltered edge first.

choices.label: Sort the cooled supports for a narrower channel
choices.outcome: You leave the growing patch intact while separating useful loose gatherings. The carrier gains a steadier place to set the jar.
choices.description: Select the run's one material bundle.

encounters.title: The Stone That Tells the Weather Early

ember_listening_stone_entry.body: A broad stone beside the steam path hums when the pressure changes underground. Travellers have pressed so many ears to it that the surface shines. Today a keeper is asking people to listen one at a time; several confident predictions have been based on each other's stomachs.

choices.label: Compare the stone with the open vent
choices.outcome: You listen from a safe edge and record when each note changes. The keeper gains a useful comparison instead of another certainty.

choices.label: Quiet the waiting crowd with your companion
choices.outcome: Your companion settles against the cool side of the shelter. The waiting travellers lower their voices until the stone can be heard.

encounters.title: One Shadow for Three Opinions

ember_manticore_shade_entry.body: A Manticore stands beneath a narrow strip of shade. Its lion face wants to rest, its wings keep shifting toward the breeze, and its tail is carefully avoiding a hot rock. Nobody has quite enough space, and the neighbouring path remains broad enough for a respectful detour.

choices.label: Move a loose shade screen from the safe edge
choices.outcome: You stop well outside the creature's reach. The longer strip gives all three restless parts a place to settle.

choices.label: Observe the wind before taking the detour
choices.outcome: The wings choose the cooler draught long before the dust changes direction. You note the clue and leave the resting place alone.

encounters.title: The Tool with Two Handles

ember_shared_tongs_entry.body: Two workers have made a long pair of tongs for lifting cooled stones from a narrow channel. Each handle needs someone on a different bank. Their argument concerns who must get wet first, while the stone between them is becoming an excellent place for moss to begin.

choices.label: Take the shallow bank and help lift together
choices.outcome: Cold water enters your boots before the stone leaves the channel. The workers discover that a shared count works better than an argument.
choices.description: Pay 3% HP; no knockouts; Temporary team attack +5%.

choices.label: Build a dry footing for the shorter worker
choices.outcome: You arrange the cool supports where both handles can be reached. The tongs finally become a tool instead of a conversation.

encounters.title: Warm Bread above the Steam Channel

ember_bread_handover_entry.body: The work crew from the bakery notes is resting above the steam channel. Their first question is whether the baker remembered to eat something herself. A covered shelf is ready beside their tools, and your companion can smell the familiar parcel before you reach the landing.

choices.label: Deliver the parcel and take their reply
choices.outcome: The crew shares the parcel and writes a short, affectionate complaint about overworking. You leave with a message rather than another delivery obligation.

choices.label: Set a reliable handover mark on the sheltered shelf
choices.outcome: You place the parcel where the crew can find it without crossing the steam. Future handovers have a clear, dry home.
choices.description: +5% of the run reward; World remembers.

encounters.title: A Garden on the Morning Route

ember_pressure_routine_entry.body: The garden below the pressure house has a new inspection board. Its neighbours have recorded heat, water and seed dates in different handwriting, leaving blank spaces where they are still unsure. A small bucket waits beneath the ordinary water channel instead of the steam pipe.

choices.label: Compare the first few honest observations
choices.outcome: You find a change worth watching without claiming to know its cause. Both neighbours add the next check to their shared route.

choices.label: Help fit a cooler handle to the inspection bucket
choices.outcome: Your companion keeps the loose strap steady while you attach it. Checking the channel becomes less likely to mean a sore hand.

encounters.title: Shade between the New Rows

ember_orchard_visitors_entry.body: In the orchard you helped survey, small residents are testing the spaces left between the trees. The keeper has resisted tidying every shelter away. A few local beasts gather on a firm patch of ground nearby, apparently interested in whether your team would like to demonstrate its own travelling habits.

choices.label: Offer a friendly two-beast demonstration
choices.outcome: Two challengers leave the saplings for the firm clearing. The keeper moves her tools aside before either team begins.

choices.label: Help the keeper mark the sheltered routes
choices.outcome: You leave the little paths wide enough to use without enlarging them into roads. The keeper records which shelters are already occupied.

encounters.title: A Sole Sewn with Wire

ember_goblin_boots_entry.body: A Goblin sits on a cool doorstep, repairing a boot with wire pulled from an old carrying basket. The repair is sturdy but will not bend. He has made the second boot equally stiff out of fairness and is now finding it difficult to stand up.

choices.label: Help add a flexible joint at the toe
choices.outcome: You keep the strong outer stitching and free the place that needs to bend. The Goblin takes an experimental, delighted step.

choices.label: Sort the basket's useful loose fibres
choices.outcome: The Goblin keeps the wire he still needs. You choose among the loose regional gatherings without dismantling another working tool.
choices.description: Select the run's one material bundle.

encounters.title: A Perch beside the Wind Gauge

ember_wyvern_post_entry.body: A Wyvern has chosen the wind gauge as a perch, making the whole instrument point wherever it looks. The keeper has stopped taking measurements rather than write down nonsense. A lower stone ledge would offer the same view without requiring anybody to persuade the Wyvern that it is an inconvenience.

choices.label: Clear the lower ledge and give it room
choices.outcome: You move the loose stones from a safe distance. The Wyvern notices the clear perch and makes its own unhurried decision.

choices.label: Read the dust trails while the gauge is occupied
choices.outcome: The ground offers a less dramatic but dependable wind record. The keeper adds your method beneath the instrument's maintenance notes.

encounters.title: A Porch Built for Cerberus

ember_three_doorways_entry.body: A shelter keeper has built three little doorways beside the same porch. Cerberus is trying each with a different head and becoming increasingly suspicious that all three lead to one room. The keeper explains that the extra doors were intended as courtesy, not as a puzzle.

choices.label: Help open the whole porch into one clear entrance
choices.outcome: You move the loose screens while the keeper holds the roof. Cerberus can see where everyone is going without three separate investigations.

choices.label: Sit outside until the visitor settles
choices.outcome: Your companion chooses a respectful distance. The keeper stops explaining, and the three heads gradually agree about the room.

encounters.title: The Warmest Stones Belong to Someone

ember_warm_creche_entry.body: A row of sun-warmed stones looks like an inviting resting place until you notice the tiny woodland insects sheltering in its cracks. A trail tender has laid a second row nearby, still warming slowly. She asks travellers to give the first row another hour of undisturbed peace.

choices.label: Rest beside the newer row instead
choices.outcome: The stones are warm enough without being occupied. Your team eases down, leaving the sheltered cracks to their small residents.

choices.label: Help make the second row easier to recognize
choices.outcome: Your companion waits while you mark a clear resting edge. The next tired traveller will not have to learn the distinction by accident.

encounters.title: A Compass Drawn with Warm Ash

ember_ash_compass_entry.body: A surveyor has drawn a circle of pale ash around a safe vent. Each drifting mark records which way the hillside has been breathing. The circle is much wider than a pocket compass, but she says the important advantage is that nobody can accidentally carry north away.

choices.label: Record the changing marks before the breeze returns
choices.outcome: You note the time beside each drift. The surveyor keeps the uncertainty in her drawing instead of smoothing it into a perfect circle.

choices.label: Mark the safer edge of the approaching draught
choices.outcome: Your companion follows the cool footing while you place the markers. Other travellers can see the sheltered side without entering the ash circle.

encounters.title: Familiar Territory · Fresh Ash on the Steps

ember_familiar_ash_path_entry.body: A new dusting of ash covers the familiar stone steps. Their edges are sound, but the powder hides the shallow gutters that keep water away from the path. The team can take the longer cool terrace or clear the gutters before using the shorter ascent.

choices.label: Brush the gutters from the stable side
choices.outcome: The ash works into your sleeves as the grooves reappear. Water will have somewhere to go when the next shower reaches the steps.
choices.description: Pay 3% HP; no knockouts; +5% of the run reward.

choices.label: Take the cool terrace in a steady line
choices.outcome: Your team keeps to the visible edges above the ash. The longer route rewards attention rather than a hurried jump.

encounters.title: Familiar Territory · The Cooled Quarry Ring

ember_familiar_quarry_ring_entry.body: Fresh tracks cross the familiar quarry practice ground. Its stones have cooled completely, and today's local challengers have pushed the loose chips outside the boundary. Two wait in the centre, leaving a clear entrance for your team and an equally clear route past the gathering.

choices.label: Accept a two-beast friendly challenge
choices.outcome: The challengers spread out on the firm stone. Your companions can find their footing before the contest begins.

choices.label: Help check the boundary for loose edges
choices.outcome: You follow the edge before anyone uses it. The team carries that careful sense of footing onto the next stretch of path.

encounters.title: Familiar Territory · The Warm Stone Shelf

ember_familiar_warm_shelf_entry.body: The familiar resting shelf holds a gentle warmth after the vents have quieted. Someone has brushed fresh ash from the seating edge and left the drinking cup upside down beneath a cover. Your companions recognize the comfortable pause between hotter and colder parts of the route.

choices.label: Rest beside the covered drinking place
choices.outcome: You turn the cup upright and share a patient break. The shelf carries the weight the team has been carrying for itself.

choices.label: Replace the cover where the ash cannot reach
choices.outcome: Your companion waits until the little cover is secure. You leave the drinking place as usable as you found it.

encounters.title: Familiar Territory · Loose Gatherings in the Runoff

ember_familiar_cooled_gatherings_entry.body: The familiar runoff bend has collected a new scatter of cooled fragments and tough fibres. Water still needs a channel through the middle, where several small residents have been passing. The higher bank offers room to sort what the current has left without closing their route.

choices.label: Select useful pieces on the higher bank
choices.outcome: You keep the water moving through its central groove. A modest bundle is chosen from the loose gatherings the hillside has already released.
choices.description: Select the run's one material bundle.

choices.label: Study the layers left by the last runoff
choices.outcome: The order of the fragments shows which current arrived first. You leave the bank's small passages open while recording it.

encounters.title: Familiar Territory · A Different Note from the Vent

ember_familiar_vent_notes_entry.body: The familiar listening vent gives a lower note today. Its stone edge remains cool enough for a safe stop, and the old warning markers are still in place. The change offers something worth recording without pretending that a single sound explains the whole hillside.

choices.label: Compare the note with the direction of the draught
choices.outcome: Your companion waits away from the opening while you make the comparison. You add a date rather than a dramatic prediction.

choices.label: Guide the team along the sheltered side
choices.outcome: You choose the footing outside the moving warm air. The team keeps a compact line until the vent is behind you.

encounters.title: Familiar Territory · The Sunstone Guest

ember_familiar_sunstone_guest_entry.body: A fresh wild visitor has claimed the familiar sunstone clearing for a rest. It notices your team, stretches and leaves the warm centre open as a challenge. The surrounding path is broad and cool, so nobody has to accept simply to continue travelling through the wastes.

choices.label: Offer one friendly battle on the firm ground
choices.outcome: The visitor moves clear of the resting hollow. Both sides have space to prepare before the first move is offered.

choices.label: Pass quietly along the cool outer path
choices.outcome: Your companion resists an unnecessary argument over a pleasant stone. The visitor settles again while your team continues together.
